channel.title: Naked Compound — Reviews
channel.description: Independent supplement research for India. Strip the label. See the science.

item.title: Dymatize Creatine Micronized Review — NSF Certified for Sport, Import Premium Examined
item.description: NSF Certified for Sport batch. Clean label, strong purity credentials. At ₹25/dose, only the right buy for competitive athletes under anti-doping testing.

item.title: Nutrabay Pure Creatine Monohydrate Review — House Brand with Public COAs
item.description: Nutrabay's house brand creatine publishes quarterly batch COAs. The most affordable domestic creatine with public purity documentation at ₹10.8 per dose.

item.title: Myprotein Creatine Monohydrate Review — Informed Sport, Sale-Dependent Value
item.description: Informed Sport certified creatine from the UK's largest supplement brand. Competitive at sale price (₹10/dose) — full price harder to justify against domestic alternatives.

item.title: MuscleBlaze CreaPRO Creatine Review — Creapure-Certified at India's Best Value
item.description: Creapure-certified creatine at ₹15/dose — the best-value Creapure option in India. Avoid the HMB variant. Stick to the standard CreaPRO.

item.title: Optimum Nutrition Micronized Creatine Review — Labdoor A+, Import Premium
item.description: Labdoor A+ rated over 15 years of US testing. ON Micronized Creatine earns its purity reputation — import pricing at ₹27.5/dose limits who should buy it.

item.title: Solgar Omnium Phytonutrient Complex — Independent Review
item.description: Independent India review of Solgar Omnium Phytonutrient Complex. NC score 6.8/10. 47 ingredients, 2 tablets daily, ~₹85/day — why the D2 vitamin D is the formula's avoidable weakness and whether the phytonutrient blend earns its premium.

item.title: Solgar Glucosamine Hyaluronic Acid Chondroitin MSM — Independent Review
item.description: Independent India review of Solgar's shellfish-free joint formula. NC score 6.6/10. 1500mg glucosamine HCl, 1200mg chondroitin, 1500mg MSM, 30mg hyaluronic acid per 3 tablets — why the shellfish-free glucosamine is useful but the HCl salt form carries the weaker evidence.

item.title: Pintola High Protein Oats — Independent Review
item.description: Independent review of Pintola High Protein Oats Dark Chocolate. NC score 5.8/10. 26g protein per 100g from soy+whey blend, ~14g sugar from organic jaggery despite 'no refined sugar' claim. ₹620/kg.

item.title: Avvatar Protein Cold Coffee Drink — Independent Review
item.description: Independent review of Avvatar Protein Cold Coffee Drink. NC score 6.5/10. 15g protein from MPC, zero added sugar, made by Parag Milk Foods — but no third-party testing and protein dose falls short of clinical benchmarks.

item.title: Dymatize ISO 100 Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate — Independent Review
item.description: Independent review of Dymatize ISO 100 Hydrolyzed WPI for India. NC score 7.0/10. NSF Certified for Sport, 25g protein per scoop, but ₹56/g protein makes it the most expensive whey in India.

item.title: MuscleBlaze Biozyme Whey — Re-review (Formulation Updated March 2026)
item.description: MuscleBlaze updated their Biozyme formula in March 2026. We re-ran the full rubric. Score moved from 7.1 to 7.6 — here's what changed and why.
